Will invisible row weft extensions damage my hair?

No, hair extensions will not damage your hair with proper application and daily maintenance. as for the invisible weft extensions NYC adjustments every two months while wearing the extensions are crucial to keeping your own natural hair healthy and growing. WHAT ARE natural beaded rows HAIR EXTENSIONS?

Say Goodbye to Heat, Glue, and Damaged Hair and Usher in the Era of Gorgeous Thick Hair

Invisible beaded rows or natural beaded rows hair extensions have become one of our most requested extensions. natural beaded row weaves do not require the use of heat and glue to secure to the head. The ease of application is the reason why several of our clients are opting for beaded weft extensions. Among women with traditional weaves, this modern option has really become popular.

The handtied wefts Extensions Will Inject Life into Your Hair

Making It More Voluminous and Lavish than Before
Our invisible beaded rows extensions are an option you cannot say “no” to until you hear about all the advantages it offers you. By opting for a natural beaded rows extensions, you will have the freedom to mix and match and reuse the same hair weft for several years, until you are ready to replace it.

Style It! Curl It! Straightened It! Color It!

It’s your hair. Do whatever you want to do with it without causing damage to your natural hair. If you have short hair, we will use the lace topper technique to install the weave.

Our beaded weft extensions makeover is perfect for you if your hair is 3 to 4 inches in length, you want to disguise a bad haircut or damaged hair, you want to add highlights, length, and volume to your own hair, or you are suffering from hair loss.

This is the Easiest and Quickest Way to Get the Hair You Always Wanted!

To perform the natural beaded rows procedure, we will use small beads to secure the hair weft to your head. The bulky feeling you get with a traditional weave will not be an issue with the invisible beaded wefts extensions, as the hair wefts lay flat on your head. Since we are not braiding your hair, your scalp has a lot of room to breathe. This means you can wash, care, and style your hair as usual.

We Use 100% European Hair

This Ensures Your hair extensions Go Undetected and Look Like Your natural hair

We use the latest tools to ensure your extensions, made of virgin human hair, stays in place. Our trained and certified hair extensions specialists will install the microbead extensions. Therefore, you can be rest assured that the micro links nyc will remain securely in place and flawlessly blend in with your hair.
